name: Night's Requiem
source:
Night has fallen. The town lays in ruin. Only Clerre Delecarre can put to rest the magical fallout that threatens to metastasize from this rotting husk. At her side is Ehrain Toleur, the very man responsible for this mess - seeking what paltry penance he can earn as he trudges through the ruins of the lives he's laid waste to.

[From [url=https://nights-requiem.itch.io/nights-requiem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜幕降临了。这座城镇已成为一片废墟。只有克莱尔·德勒卡雷（Clerre Delecarre）才能平息这片腐烂的外壳中可能扩散的魔法余波。在她身边的是埃兰·托勒尔（Ehrain Toleur），他就是这场混乱的罪魁祸首——在他所蹂躏的生命废墟中艰难前行时，他正在寻求微不足道的忏悔。

[来自[url=https://nights-requiem.itch.io/nights-requiem]Itch.io[/url]]
